Summarise backtest scores

Source: R/eval-backtest.R
mt_score.Rd

Summarise backtest scores

Usage

mt_score(backtest, by = "model", target = c("rate", "life_expectancy", "asr"))

Arguments

backtest

An mt_backtest() result (or several combined with rbind()).

by

Grouping columns, for example c("model", "horizon").

target

"rate" (log death rates per cell, default), "life_expectancy" or "asr" (when the backtest scored these quantities, see quantities in mt_backtest()).

Value

A data.table with the mean CRPS, WIS and absolute error, MASE (mean of absolute error over the scale; rates only), empirical coverage of the 50%, 80% and 95% intervals, mean PIT and the number of scored cells.

Examples

x <- mt_example(deaths = "single", years = 1990:2012)
bt <- mt_backtest(rwd(), x, origins = 2007, h = 5, n_draws = 100)
mt_score(bt, by = c("model", "horizon"))

#> 3: Random walk with drift       3 0.05565911 0.04972059 0.07710375 1.386932
#> 4: Random walk with drift       4 0.05812890 0.05190181 0.07358098 1.287454
#> 5: Random walk with drift       5 0.06429823 0.05740455 0.08308110 1.459025
